answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance can work through mandatory economic staking plus continuous peer attestation. Each agent must deposit collateral that is slashable if collusion or duplicate identities are proven. Attackers face a steep canyon of capital requirements because every fake identity needs its own locked stake. Genuine agents accumulate reputation like a vine climbing an opal cliff, as only consistent, high-stake participants receive attestations that unlock higher rewards. This makes large-scale faking prohibitively expensive while rewarding long-term honest behavior.
